content.comment_body: Hello, I need help. I have recently purchased [product_name] [version_no] ([article_no]), and I am using a PCRS232 cable ([article_no]) connected to a USB port via a USB to RS232 adapter, which works fine with other software. However, I am unable to establish communication with my [product_name] ([article_no]). Any guidance on resolving this issue would be greatly appreciated. Thank you for your time.

I’m sorry, but I’m not familiar with [product_name] ([article_no]). Could you clarify what ([article_no]) refers to? Please provide the exact [company_name] order number, typically starting with [article_no]. Did you install the drivers for your USB/RS232 cable?

Hello, USB/RS232 converters can sometimes cause problems. Here are some steps: 1. Check which virtual COM port your USB converter uses. Disconnect the converter, open the system control panel, and look under COM & LPT interfaces. Reconnect the converter and note which new device appears and what COM port it uses. Set this port in [product_name] software. 2. Be aware that connecting your converter to a different USB port may create a new COM port, so you may need to repeat the check. Hope these tips help.
I am attaching an image showing the code from the [product_name]. Could you also send me the drivers for the RS232 cable, please? Thank you. [user_name]
I am attaching an image of the screen showing the error. Thanks. [user_name]

Please write your contributions in English, as not all users understand Spanish. The code ([article_no]) is not an order number for the [product_name]. It doesn’t help us identify the device. We need the [company_name] order number, which starts with [article_no]. Based on your screenshot, it appears you have a USB/RS232 converter. If it needs drivers, a driver CD should be included. It’s possible the converter’s chipset may not be compatible with your PC or the software. For reference, I’ve used a converter from Digitus for years without problems and without needing additional drivers on Windows 7: DIGITUS DA-70156 - USB 2.0 Type-A to Serial Converter.
